training_policy: first development R only; no S/Fox fitting or labels in inference
method: fit an HTTP-only evidence tree without five rate/count features; lower original score only for complete successful GET/HEAD, evidence score<=0.05 and no retention guard
guards: retain original on payload/scanner flags, >=100 requests/sec or >=500/min buckets, ambiguous/unavailable evidence or missing/invalid context
selection_history: two exploratory feature projections were compared on already observed vectors; the minimal five-feature exclusion was retained; a direct replacement introduced false positives, so conservative one-way lowering was chosen; successful read-only scope is narrower than the preliminary 4-FP prototype
acceptance: all three web access sources FPR<=5%, recall>=95%, no prior TP lost at 0.95, no new FP, non-HTTP scores identical; this does not qualify the six-domain independent goal
